frontier_selector.why: The patient's history of a 5 mm‐thick melanoma on his posterior neck treated six years earlier and the development of new lesions, including a lung mass and a hyoid bone lesion, which are consistent with metastatic disease, decided it.

support_spans: Endobronchial ultrasound–guided fine-needle aspiration of the lung lesion demonstrated a malignant small round blue cell tumor
Molecular studies were negative for an EWSR1 translocation but otherwise were interpreted as consistent with Ewing sarcoma/primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET)
contradict_spans: development of right neck adenopathy and interval growth of the hyoid bone lesion, suggesting a distinct pathology

support_spans: an intensely FDG-avid, partially calcified 4.1 × 2.3 × 2.8 cm expansile lesion within the right hyoid bone
contradict_spans: Mid-treatment PET/CT demonstrated a substantial decrease in size and complete metabolic response of the lung mass
